ABOUT THE PROJECT

A small lab for a big part of the game.

Audience: beginner college soccer players who want to practice reading space and weighing risk.

Choose a role, answer paired match scenarios, and compare your decisions when leading or trailing. Each round awards 0–2 context-fit points; the score is practice feedback, not a measure of real soccer ability.

All scenarios and outcomes are original, simplified teaching examples developed with ChatGPT. They are not coach-validated or simulations. Other decisions may be reasonable depending on player skill, movement and team instructions.

No account, personal information, external API, or tracking is required. Progress resets when you reload. See the submission's AI_USE_NOTE.md for development disclosure.
